hero.title: Safety for all.
hero.description: At Mera Driver, the well-being of our customers and driver partners is above everything else. We are constantly in pursuit of enhancing our safety measures to ensure every Mera Driver booking is a pleasant, safe, and comfortable experience.

items.title: For Customers
items.description: Every ride is tracked by Mera Driver 24/7, with real-time access to granular telemetry, latitudinal and longitudinal route data, and SOS support.

items.title: For Drivers & Partners
items.description: From background verification to safety training and emergency monitoring checks, we take all necessary steps to ensure our driver partners' safety.

measuresBanner.title: Measures to ensure the well-being of both, our Drivers and Customers.

measures.title: Comprehensive Trip Insurance
measures.description: Insurance coverage for any trip incident occurring during the ride covering medical treatment, hospitalization, and accidental benefits.

measures.title: 24/7 Safety Control Desk
measures.description: Round-the-clock emergency assistance and real-time ride tracking team available at a single tap.

measures.title: Background Verified Drivers
measures.description: Rigorous identity checks, driving license validation, and police background verification for every driver partner.

measures.title: Rating & Safety Reviews
measures.description: Two-way rating system ensuring respectful, reliable, and high-standard commuting environment for everyone.

wayForward.title: Way forward on Safety
wayForward.subtitle: To further substantiate our commitment to Safety First towards customers & driver partners, we are incorporating advanced safety features on our platform.

features.title: Night Ride Completion Check
features.description: Anyone who takes a ride between 10 pm and 6 am is proactively contacted by Mera Driver Customer Support to ensure safe arrival.

features.title: Proactive Route Check-In
features.description: Every rider and driver will be alerted or called by Mera Driver Safety Team whenever an unexpected route deviation or long stop occurs.
